text: Artificial intelligence is becoming part of our daily lives, so ethical questions are more important than ever. One major concern is bias: if AI learns from unfair data, it can make unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or even medical care. Fairness means treating everyone equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also a key issue, because AI systems often collect and use personal information. People have the right to know how their data is used. Transparency helps here—companies should explain how their AI works. Finally, responsible AI development means building technology that respects human values and benefits society as a whole.
